query: SELECT p.id, p.owner_id, p.visibility AS "visibility: Visibility", p.name, p.description, p.created_at AS "created_at: DateTime<Utc>", p.updated_at AS "updated_at: DateTime<Utc>", c.done AS "done_cards!", c.total AS "total_cards!" FROM projects p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.counts_as_done) AS done, count(*) AS total FROM project_cards pc JOIN project_lanes l ON l.id = pc.lane_id WHERE pc.project_id = p.id AND pc.owner_id = $1 AND pc.deleted_at IS NULL) c WHERE p.owner_id = $1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ($2::text IS NULL OR p.name ILIKE $2) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR p.visibility = $3) AND ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR (p.created_at, p.id) < ($4::timestamptz, $5::uuid)) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT $6
